Folders: grey or colour

Top row: a first run, nothing connected. Bottom row: someone with a dozen apps. Same seven folders, real icons.

A. Today: yours in colour, the rest grey

B. Every icon in colour, yours lead

C. Every icon in colour, yours ticked

My pick: B. A folder is a catalogue first: in colour, like the App Library, it invites a tap on day one instead of reading as switched off. Yours still lead each folder and "3 of 21" says how full it is; inside, apps you could add keep the pink plus. C adds a tick, which is one more mark to read at 23pt. A is the most honest at a glance but makes a first run a wall of grey.
